title: Power Tower
statementMd:
Priests of the Quetzalcoatl cult want to build a tower to represent a power of their god. Tower is usually made of power-charged rocks. It is built with the help of rare magic by levitating the current top of tower and adding rocks at its bottom. If top, which is built from $*k* - 1$ rocks, possesses power $*p*$ and we want to add the rock charged with power $*w*_{*k*}$ then value of power of a new tower will be ${*w*_{*k*}}^{*p*}$.

Rocks are added from the last to the first. That is for sequence $*w*_{1}, ..., *w*_{*m*}$ value of power will be

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4ef378778da9b60d06657e4d0d62af081aedc49.png)

After tower is built, its power may be extremely large. But still priests want to get some information about it, namely they want to know a number called cumulative power which is the true value of power taken modulo $*m*$. Priests have $*n*$ rocks numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. They ask you to calculate which value of cumulative power will the tower possess if they will build it from rocks numbered $*l*, *l* + 1, ..., *r*$.

## Input

First line of input contains two integers $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$).

Second line of input contains $*n*$ integers $*w*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *w*_{*k*} ≤ 10^{9}$) which is the power of rocks that priests have.

Third line of input contains single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$) which is amount of queries from priests to you.

$*k*^{*th*}$ of next $*q*$ lines contains two integers $*l*_{*k*}$ and $*r*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*k*} ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Output $*q*$ integers. $*k*$-th of them must be the amount of cumulative power the tower will have if is built from rocks $*l*_{*k*}, *l*_{*k*} + 1, ..., *r*_{*k*}$.

## Note

$3^{27} = 7625597484987$
statementZhMd:
祭司们想要建造一座塔，以象征他们的神所拥有的幂。塔通常由充满力量的岩石构成。借助罕见的魔法，祭司们将当前的塔顶悬浮起来，并在塔底添加岩石来建造塔。若塔顶由 $*k* - 1$ 块岩石构成，其力量为 $*p*$，现在要添加一块力量为 $*w*_{*k*}$ 的岩石，那么新塔的力量将为 ${*w*_{*k*}}^{*p*}$。

岩石按照从最后一块到第一块的顺序添加。也就是说，对于序列 $*w*_{1}, ..., *w*_{*m*}$，其力量为

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4ef378778da9b60d06657e4d0d62af081aedc49.png)

塔建成后，其力量可能会非常大。但祭司们仍然希望获取关于它的一些信息：他们想知道一个称为累积力量的数值，即真实力量对 $*m*$ 取模后的结果。祭司们有 $*n*$ 块编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的岩石。他们请你计算：如果使用编号为 $*l*, *l* + 1, ..., *r*$ 的岩石建造塔，那么该塔的累积力量是多少。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*w*_{*k}$（$1 ≤ *w*_{*k*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示祭司们拥有的岩石的力量。

输入的第三行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示祭司向你提出的询问数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，第 $*k*^{*th*}$ 行包含两个整数 $*l*_{*k*}$ 和 $*r*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*k*} ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出 $*q*$ 个整数。其中第 $*k*$ 个整数必须是使用编号为 $*l*_{*k*}, *l*_{*k*} + 1, ..., *r*_{*k*}$ 的岩石建造塔时，该塔所拥有的累积力量。

## 说明

$3^{27} = 7625597484987$
